decision.name: Documented Apple empty-selected-set result semantics
decision.detail: No public Apple ps(1) contract states the exit status/stdout/stderr tuple for an exact process-group query selecting no processes, or guarantees that this tuple distinguishes an empty observable set from a failed/incomplete query. POSIX nonzero-is-error does not authorize interpreting Apple exit 1 plus empty output as GONE.
decision.whyNotProbeToInfer: User requires public contract before controls. A fresh control could characterize a result but cannot supply the missing public guarantee.

selectionCandidateNotExecuted.selection: One positive persisted owned PGID only; no other selection option; -x retains processes without a controlling terminal; header-free numeric fields would be validated exactly.
selectionCandidateNotExecuted.publicSelectionBasis: Installed Apple ps(1), options -g, -x, -o and keywords pid/pgid. Apple-specific group selection; POSIX -g means session-leader selection and is not substituted.
selectionCandidateNotExecuted.legacyHazard: Installed ps(1) says legacy -g is ignored; installed compat(5) documents explicit COMMAND_MODE=unix2003.
selectionCandidateNotExecuted.scopeIfLaterAdmitted: Fresh bounded same-user groups with no credential changes, privileged descendants or escaping children; macOS only. No historical group, Linux, arbitrary child tree, or unrestricted visibility qualification.
